title: Nanopore sensing with machine learning-assisted analysis for real-time single-molecule detection of MDM2-p53TAD interactions.
authors: Kim, Jinhyung; Ha, Taeyoung; Park, Soyoung; Kang, Dongwoo; Lee, Sunju; Lee, Seongwon; Oh, Sohee; Chung, Minji; Chi, Seung-Wook; Kim, Seung Jun; Hyon, YunKyong; Lee, Mi-Kyung
one_liner_zh: 该文用纳米孔传感与机器学习检测MDM2-p53蛋白-蛋白互作，对象为PPI而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅方法上机器学习可迁移，与课题关联微弱。
abstract: Protein-protein interactions (PPIs) play pivotal roles in physiological processes but remain challenging drug targets. Conventional PPI detection methods often suffer from limited sensitivity and require time- and labor-intensive procedures, such as fluorophore labeling, restricting their utility in drug discovery. Here, we present a YaxAB nanopore sensing platform coupled with machine learning-assisted signal analysis for label-free, real-time, single-molecule detection of PPIs between the oncogenic murine double minute 2 (MDM2) protein and p53TAD1. Proteins were efficiently captured into the YaxAB nanopore, and free MDM2 generated ionic current signatures readily distinguishable from those of the MDM2-p53TAD1 complex. To enable rapid and quantitative event analysis, we developed a machine learning-based classification framework that accurately distinguished free MDM2, MDM2-p53TAD1 complexes, and MDM2-drug complexes directly from nanopore current traces. This integrated platform enabled automated interpretation of single-molecule events, real-time monitoring of PPI inhibition by small-molecule MDM2 antagonists, and estimation of drug binding affinity without labeling or ensemble averaging. Taken together, the YaxAB nanopore sensing and machine learning analysis platform provides a versatile approach for single-molecule interaction analysis, with potential applications in drug discovery, diagnostics, including protein probe-biomarker interaction assays.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPIs）在生理过程中发挥关键作用，但作为药物靶点仍具挑战性。传统PPI检测方法常受限于灵敏度不足，且需耗时费力的操作步骤，如荧光标记，限制了其在药物发现中的应用。在此，我们提出一种YaxAB纳米孔传感平台，结合机器学习辅助信号分析，实现对致癌性鼠双微体2（MDM2）蛋白与p53TAD1之间PPIs的无标记、实时、单分子检测。蛋白质被高效捕获至YaxAB纳米孔中，游离MDM2产生的离子电流特征与MDM2-p53TAD1复合物的特征易于区分。为实现快速定量事件分析，我们开发了一种基于机器学习的分类框架，可直接从纳米孔电流迹线中准确区分游离MDM2、MDM2-p53TAD1复合物及MDM2-药物复合物。该集成平台实现了单分子事件的自动化解读、小分子MDM2拮抗剂对PPI抑制的实时监测，以及无需标记或系综平均的药物结合亲和力估算。综上，YaxAB纳米孔传感与机器学习分析平台为单分子相互作用分析提供了一种通用方法，在药物发现、诊断学（包括蛋白质探针-生物标志物相互作用检测）中具有潜在应用价值。
